remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

spec2def(wshom.ocx wshom.ocx.spec)
add_idl_headers(wshom_idlheader wshom.idl)

list(APPEND wshom_rc_deps ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/wshom.rgs)

add_idl_reg_objects(wshom regtypelib wshom.idl)

# wshom.ocx is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wshom-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(wshom_shims OBJECT network.c shell.c wshom_main.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(wshom_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload oldnames liboleaut32 libole32 libscrrun libshell32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(wshom_shims)
add_dependencies(wshom_shims stdole2 wshom_idlheader)
set(WSHOM_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/wshom.ocx/wshom_t.o)
add_cargo_module(wshom wshom-cargo wshom.ocx
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS wshom_shims psdk wshom_t ${WSHOM_REUSED} uuid_sources)
